note: Labels here were set by an independent reviewer, not by Claude Code. The provisional manifest is preserved unchanged as the record of what was proposed. Cases excluded from metrics can never re-enter precision or recall.

contactSheet.layout: 3 panels top row, 2 centred beneath; panels 640x360; labelled F1..F5 with timestamps

splitMethod: sha256('split-seed-v2:'+pexelsId), first hex char < '8' => calibration, else holdout; keyed on source id so a clip reused across cases cannot straddle the split

cases.narration: Traffic cameras watch the same intersection from above.

cases.provisionalRationale: Camera and roadway must appear in one shot.
cases.reviewCaution: Gantry over the motorway resolves clearly at 640px, and a dark unit is visible on it — but whether that is a traffic CAMERA or variable-message-sign equipment is a genuine judgement call. Visible SCANIA/OETL truck branding in F2 (brand risk POSSIBLE). Reviewer should decide DIRECT vs AMBIGUOUS.

review.note: The motorway and gantry are clear, but no traffic/security camera is reliably identifiable in the sampled frames; the dark gantry unit could be other road equipment. Visible truck branding also creates brand-risk concern. Exclude from hard metrics or re-source.
